about_the_game:
Create a coven of witches, defeat the great Blight and harvest its soul. Soul Cauldron is a Min-Maxing dungeon runner set in a dying world, where covens of powerful witches vie for power as everything around them is slowly consumed by the enigmatic Blight.

Min-Maxing Challenge: Different builds for every occasion

Unlike traditional RPG-s where you build your character in a certain way throughout the playthrough, in Soul Cauldron each dungeon will have highly different challenges that no single build will be good against. The build that you used to easily run the previous Dungeon will have you killed on arrival in the next one.

Instead, you completely reequip your character with items and spells that suit the specific challenge.

Divine your future to survive

Since you need to equip for each new challenge, knowing what to expect is the difference between life or death. Your witches will painstakingly divine information about dungeons to reveal enemy strengths, weaknesses, notable items, and how will breaching the dungeon further empower the Blight. Powerful witches can even unlock powerful bonus effects to help you survive the dungeon.

Decisions, Decisions

Maybe you divine the presence of the recipe for a potion of Celestial Mending in a pit full of Fire Demons. Will you risk entering when you're missing a good fire resistant armor? You could use that potion to survive the venom attacks of the creatures in the Dark Bog. If you could survive that Bog, its guardian holds the Astral Spellblade you need to complete your Fiend slaying item set.

How many souls can you collect to fuel your cauldron?

On the battered continent of Ique, the only true currency is souls. Venture out into the wilderness, fight monsters, craft spells, brew potions and utilize almost infinite combos from six schools of magic to build your coven!

Collect your Sisters, slay the avatar of the Blight and claim it's soul so you may found the greatest coven to ever exist!

  • Fight your way through dungeons, swamps and ruins infested by pirate gangs, cults, demons, undead, arcane entities and other horrors; and harvest their souls to increase your power.

  • Discover recipes for powerful spells, potions and runes to craft.

  • Semi-procedural itemization will give you unending tools and combinations to accomplish your goal, but beware: you will face greater and more powerful enemies along the way!

  • Use your powers of divination to gather information on dungeons before you enter, and outfit your witch with great care so she may have a chance at survival.

  • Find your lost sisters and save them from the clutches of the enemy so they can join your cause!

  • Use over 500 unique, craftable spells and elevate your coven over all others.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains cartoon like depiction of blood, gore and violent deaths.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 6300 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660; AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires at least 1080p resolution

short_description: Create a Coven of Witches in this Min-Maxing dungeon runner, where you redesign your characters for every new dungeon with over 500 unique spells and in 6 spheres of magic. Get ready for hours of stat comparing, synergy building and running side quests for that set item you're missing.
